topic: Lactic acid: not just fatigue, but a signaling molecule
caption: Lactic acid isn't just a fatigue marker 🏋️‍♀️. It's a key signaling molecule in your body 📣. Did you know that lactic acid helps regulate your immune system 🤧, influences your metabolism 🍴, and even affects your brain function 🧠? Save this so you don't lose it 💾.
